stories.headline: Estonia ready to discuss military support for US Strait of Hormuz operations
stories.summary: Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur and Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna stated Estonia is prepared to discuss sending military forces to help secure the Strait of Hormuz if the US makes an official request. No concrete request has been received yet.

stories.headline: Lockheed Martin to establish HIMARS maintenance center in Estonia
stories.summary: Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur and Lockheed Martin agreed to establish a HIMARS missile system maintenance center in Estonia that will serve all three Baltic states. The $10 million investment represents strengthened defense cooperation with the US.

stories.headline: Russian fighter jet violates Estonian airspace
stories.summary: A Russian SU-30 fighter aircraft violated Estonian airspace near Vaindloo Island for approximately one minute on March 18. Estonia summoned the Russian charge d'affaires and NATO's Baltic Air Policing mission responded.

stories.headline: Explosion at Russian military base near Estonia
stories.summary: A large explosion occurred at a Russian military base in Pskov, 32 kilometers from Estonia. Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur said it was likely a fuel depot that was hit, possibly by Ukrainian forces.

stories.headline: Estonian border guards injured in Mediterranean accident
stories.summary: Estonian border patrol boat M-80 sank during a Frontex operation in Greek waters. Four Estonians and one Greek were on board, with two Estonian border guards in serious condition. All survived.

stories.headline: Russian citizen expelled from Estonia over security concerns
stories.summary: KAPO expelled Russian citizen Kirill Kudriavtsev for national security reasons, citing his ties to Russian intelligence services. He was also issued a Schengen entry ban.

articles.title: Russian citizen expelled from Estonia days after entering country

stories.headline: Presidential election discussions and candidate speculation
stories.summary: Discussions continue about Estonia's presidential election with parties considering candidates. Social Democrats mentioned diplomat Riina Kionka as a potential candidate suggested by Reform Party, though Kionka states no party has contacted her directly.

stories.headline: EKRE holds party congress in Viljandi
stories.summary: Conservative People's Party held its council meeting in Viljandi, adopting political statements focused on economic growth, defending the nation-state, and radical changes to migration policy ahead of next year's parliamentary elections.

stories.headline: Coop Pank launches bond offering to raise capital
stories.summary: Coop Pank announced a public offering of subordinated bonds worth 10 million euros to strengthen its capital base and support growth plans. The bank aims to achieve a 10% market share in Estonia by 2030.

stories.headline: Parliament advisor dismissed over gambling tax legislation error
stories.summary: A veteran Riigikogu advisor was dismissed following a disciplinary procedure related to an error in gambling tax legislation that cost the state millions. Opposition claims the advisor was made a scapegoat for politicians' mistakes.

stories.headline: EU adopts Estonian initiative on Russian fighter visa bans
stories.summary: The European Union agreed to work on Estonia's initiative to impose visa restrictions on Russian fighters who served in Ukraine. Twenty-five EU countries supported examining the proposal.
